title_zh: 字节跳动：算法改变内容世界
title_en: Chinese Companies (5/20): ByteDance and the Algorithm That Changed Content
note_en: 就 (jiù) before a verb signals that something happened sooner or more easily than you might expect: 很快就风靡全国 "swept the country almost at once," 在很短时间内就吸引了全球数十亿用户 "attracted billions of users in no time." English needs words like "already" or "right away"; Chinese drops 就 in front of the verb, and the sentence sounds flat without it.
